title: EmDash: an unticked page takes its links, home block and child pages; a child a kept page still lists stays reachable
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test packages/cms/tracy-emdash-theme-business/tests/page-gate.test.mjs packages/cms/tracy-emdash-theme-saas/tests/page-gate.test.mjs packages/cms/tracy-emdash-theme-base/tests/page-gate.test.mjs
S2: Read the exit code and the fail count.
expect: page-records.ts is the same file in the three themes; a link into an unticked page record is not live, a child of it is live only when the listed set (kept pages) names it, and the unticked page itself never is.

SaaS seed, Blog unticked: every Engineering post and the six category views of All categories (with their posts) are listed; posts only in the blog's root category, tag views and author pages are not; with Engineering and All categories unticked too, nothing is listed.
Business seed, News unticked with Investors kept: exactly the four disclosures Investors shows are listed. Base seed, Blog unticked with Team kept: exactly the Team notes.
Buttons into an unticked page (content sections, header, footer, 404, sitemap, search, Business kit mockups) sit under live(...); child views answer 404 through the same gate.

selectors.gate: linkChecker / sitePath in src/lib/page-records.ts of each EmDash theme
selectors.listed: listedChildren in src/lib/listed-children.ts of each EmDash theme

evidence: Dev, Tracy Business 1.7.1 (tamq-9e-bizvi): Projects unticked, /projects answered 404 but the home page still drew 10 project links and /projects/<slug> opened. Decision 08/10/2026 (#1013): links into an unticked page go, its children go too, except a child a kept page still lists (SaaS: Blog unticked, Engineering / All categories kept).
fence: Units on the pure gate and each template's seed, plus source checks of the wiring. Not exercised here: a running site (done by hand for the PR with clean installs and a link crawl), the dev surface.
